name: Fey Healing, Greater
body:
School transmutation (healing); Level druid 5, magus 5, shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner 5, witch 5
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 15)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like fey healing except it grants fast healing 3 and a +1 morale bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells or effects.
